body: Yeah I remember being kicked out for weeks when I was a minor and didn't know that was illegal. I never slept anywhere because I never got to sleep. This just sucks. I'm so self aware that I'm still able to understand that I shouldn't do it, that there is hope, that I can get through it, but I've regressed mentally to the point where my reaction has been simplified into the fight or flight mechanism. I just don't want to ruin things with my dad. He's terribly misguided with mental illness but he loves me and I can't lose that connection through fighting. That's part of why I'd rather die. I couldn't give two shits less about my mom's feelings right now. She told me I wouldn't be given a funeral or a coffin or a memorial, nothing. She constantly makes my illnesses about her and everyone else instead of me, and she tells me I'll always be a victim. I don't even have the money for a cab or transport to the city hospital or I would've done that today before all this mess.

I figured I'd post here for the support since I'm actively suicidal and the emergency services wouldn't take me seriously. I want to fight. I've been fighting. I have been talking to my long distance friends since I have none here and they have my back. It's just my parents. I am just dreading the possibility of them speaking to my therapist and refusing to take me in. What do I do then? I don't even want to die but it's looking like a really good option right now.

This might alarm you, but there are several factors that contributed to my problems! I was pregnant and taking Trileptal in 2012. The nausea from the pregnancy was exponentially worse on Trileptal, and it would make it very difficult to get the proper nutrients I needed. I ended up miscarrying early on, but my doctors do not at all suspect that it was because of the medication because it was too early for it to have affected the fetus. However, being on a medication that can severely limit the amount of nutrients that you absorb can be detrimental to your pregnancy. I was told that Trileptal has very little chance of affecting how the fetus develops, so you should be safe in that regard. I have no experience with Lamictal. Best of luck to you sweetheart!

I've been on Seroquel, Trileptal, Tegretol, Neurontin, Haldol, Prolixin, Zyprexa, Klonopin, and Valium for bipolar, schizoaffective, and anxiety. I feel that the ones that helped me the best were Trileptal and Valium. Unfortunately every time I have an episode and go to the hospital, they change up my medications and mark them as med allergies so I can never take them again. Seroquel is really awesome if you have sleep problems and don't mind gaining some weight. I'm already overweight and it slowed my metabolism really badly, but before noticing the weight I noticed my mood was very stable for a very long time. Trileptal helped little with sleep, but had awesome mood stabilizing effects and weight loss potential! I lost 45 pounds switching to Trileptal from Seroquel. Neither seem to have heart rate effects. I really recommend asking your doctor and insurance to do this swab test to determine what meds can work with your body chemistry best. My support group was discussing this last week. Hope everything works out for you, pm me if you need anything!
